text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —Chowaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... It has been decided!
Behold the Bakushin Secret Technique: Bakushin Ring Toss!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible...! So fast my eyes can barely keep up, all six of them...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-It's missing the mark...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
Swoosh! KABOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —All rounds on target. Target silence confirmed. Order 'Target Shooting,' complete.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoa~! Bourbon-san is sooo cool~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That definitely wasn't the sound of a cork gun!
Wait, isn't there a hole straight through the prize?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I managed to cut out the shapes too!
The shopkeeper said they'll give us some candy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! You made it in the shape of a bird.
Every single feather is standing out, it's so pretty...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you very much.
I got so carried away that I even made the tiny feathers on my own.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Effect on emotional state confirmed... Cross-reference complete.
Meets the definition of a work of art.
Recording for the archives is recommended. Taking photo—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: In that case! Take my cutout candy too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eh, when did you...!
Wait... huh? You aren't holding anything...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I Bakushin'd so hard,
it all turned to powder!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you Bakushin-ing a bit too much?!
...Though to be honest, I've been wondering
about this the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Rice-san, you sure eat a lot, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-You think so...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Again?! But you just had a meat bun a second ago! Is it magic?!
Everyone's quirks are so intense... I-Iâ

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"This is too much fun~! It's just a regular festival,
but it feels like a theme park ride~!
I want to do something fun too~!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. When you smile like a blooming flower,
Tannhauser-san... it's really delightful♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Truly...
Ehehe, playing together with everyone makes me so happy...♪
